verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a broad programmatic surface. It has OpenAPI specs for 'every public API', described as the single source of truth. It covers Checkout and payment APIs, the Product Feed and agentic APIs, and Management API operations for merchant accounts, terminals, webhooks, users, API credentials and allowed origins, all exposed via MCP tools. That shows many admin tasks normally done in the Customer Area are API-reachable. However, nothing claims UI/API parity, and several capabilities are described only as Customer Area/UI features: credential role assignment, webhook event logs, the risk rule-builder interface and visual reporting. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, documented API coverage for Customer Area features such as webhook logs, reporting, risk rules and role assignment, and independent hands-on corroboration.
